title: SourceSpec
description: Structured analysis of how one feature is implemented in the source SDK repo. This is the cross-repo bridge: the implementer runs with its cwd pinned to the TARGET repo and never reads the source tree itself, so anything missing here is invisible downstream.

configKey.description: Exact JS/JSON key an integrator writes, e.g. paymentMethodOrder. Highest-signal field in the spec — for config-category gaps the implementation is verified against its literal presence in the diff.

defaultValue.description: Value when absent, e.g. None or false

behavior.description: What observably changes when this is set

allRelatedFiles.description: Every SOURCE-repo file involved. These are source paths; the target repo's corresponding files are found by the implementer and cannot be derived from this list mechanically.

path.description: Relative to the source repo root

implementationSteps.description: Ordered, each naming a concrete edit
